import numpy as np
import pytest
from shop_analysis.checkout import discount_rate, phase_advance


def test_discount_at_zero():
    assert discount_rate(np.array([0.0]), 2.0, 0.0)[0] == 2.0


def test_discount_symmetric():
    s = np.linspace(-1, 1, 5)
    b = discount_rate(s, 2.0, 0.0)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(b, b[::-1])


def test_discount_waist_shift():
    s = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 2.0])
    b = discount_rate(s, 1.0, 1.0)
    assert b.argmin() == 1


def test_phase_advance_monotonic():
    s = np.linspace(0, 10, 101)
    mu = phase_advance(s, discount_rate(s, 2.0, 0.0))
    assert np.all(np.diff(mu) > 0)


def test_phase_advance_rejects_zero_discount():
    with pytest.raises(FloatingPointError):
        with np.errstate(divide="raise"):
            phase_advance(np.array([0.0, 1.0]), np.array([0.0, 1.0]))
